$comment: Mirror of sprk_analysisaction.sprk_inputschema for billing-rule-draft (ebilling-r1 task 075, FR-27, D-27). The Action is a Linear AI Consumer reached only through IInvoiceAi.DraftRulesAsync (the Binding carries no tool description, so it is never loop-projected); the schema documents the operand the facade sends as the '## Input' section ({ documentText, ruleTypes }) and is validated by CatalogInputSchemaContractTests like every other mirror. Property-level "required": true is FORBIDDEN (use the object-level required array). actionCode carries NO version suffix. The document id and tenant id travel in the LinearRunContext / logs, never in the operand. Deployed to the row by scripts/ebilling/Ensure-ActionRow.ps1.

documentText.description: The extracted text of the guideline, rate letter or internal procedure, or one part of a long one (BillingRuleDraftJobHandler splits a long text at paragraph breaks).

ruleTypes.description: The closed list of billing rule types the proposals must come from: the eleven types of BillingRuleCatalogue, each with its parameter schema (the type member itself is left out; the application adds it).

ruleType.description: The rule type name, e.g. TimeIncrement. The answer copies it exactly.

description.description: What the rule type checks, in one sentence.

parameterSchema.description: The JSON Schema of the type's parameters, embedded as JSON.
